errors.description: The belt spans the full width of the frame but occupies only a narrow horizontal band of its height, so by area it sits below the 40-80% fill the CLOSE CROP directive targets. It is nonetheless the only hardware in frame and reads instantly.
errors.expected: the belt filling 40-80% of the frame
errors.actual: a full-width band across roughly the middle of the frame
errors.correction: a landscape frame would be the only way to raise the fill ratio without losing the belt's full run across the back

notes: Attempt 2. The logged major from attempt 1 - a belt roughly 40-50% wider than the 3 cm the option is named for - is fixed, verified by re-measuring the belt-width to back-panel-width ratio rather than guessing absolute scale: 6.5% rendered against 7.6% drawn, where attempt 1 was 12.9%. The buckle was scaled down with it. Nothing that was already correct changed: the hatching is still correctly read as plain lining rather than stripes, and orientation, centred buckle, strap geometry, centre back seam, V-notch hem, suppression, background and frame cleanliness all survived. Only the framing note remains.
